description: Canonical typed reward relationship schema for Parallel Quests.

fields.skills: Canonical skill IDs or names resolved against skills.json.
fields.super_souls: Canonical Super Soul IDs or names resolved against the Super Soul domain.
fields.clothing: Canonical clothing IDs or exact names resolved against the clothing domain.
fields.accessories: Canonical accessory IDs or exact names resolved against the accessory domain.
fields.sources: One or more provenance records supporting the reward relationship.

relationship_rules: Never treat an empty typed array as proof that an alternate acquisition route does not exist.
Never silently merge two differently named rewards; retain aliases or source conflicts.
A skill relationship must resolve to one canonical skill identity or an explicit unresolved/conflict record.
DLC provenance should be represented at the PQ record and collectible record where applicable.
Reverse indexes must be generated from these typed maps rather than maintained independently by hand.
